name: Yatogami Tooka
source:
Code name: "Princess"
Angel: Sandalphon
Astral Dress: Adonai Melek

Yatogami Tooka's name is given by Shidou when they first met. Due to being a spirit, she is always being targeted by the AST and is aiming for the kill, because of that she hated humans for always shunning her and thinking that she wasn't allowed to live in this world, but her whole life changed when she met Shidou.

Even with that high and cool presence, Tooka lacks some common sense and loves food very much.

[Taken from [url=http://myanimelist.net/character/65259/Tohka_Yatogami]MyAnimeList[/url]]
